headline: S265 tightened startup truth and AI discovery routing after the primary genius list was exhausted.

items.title: Startup active-age truth guard
items.insight: Startup now rejects numeric session ids as activity dates. The next agent sees a current context signal instead of a misleading 20K-day stale marker.

items.title: AI discovery route resolver
items.insight: Agents now get the real on-site canonical routes for projects whose slug or category does not match the old heuristic. Discovery points to committed shards instead of silently leaving local pages under-indexed.

followUps: Run post-push CI/deploy confirmation for the S265 tip.
Use a fresh trace-backed LCP pass before attempting to close the homepage Lighthouse floor advisory.
